value: From the scarlet fields of the Eastern Plaguelands, the search climbs to the old troll ziggurat. Two tablets are found among its stones, bringing Ironboot another pair. The seeker carries the record deeper into the plague-scarred north, where the ziggurat adds its fragment to the tale.
editorNote: Original paraphrase. Scene order follows quest-chain order and does not assert exact date or unsupported causal links. Secondary locators and original-client limits are recorded in the research packet.
